summary: 29-year-old solo hiker found dead from traumatic injuries after apparent fall on the Dallas-Gilpin ridge below Gilpin Peak.
location: Dallas-Gilpin ridge, upper Mill Creek Basin (near Mt. Sneffels / Mt. Emma)
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff; San Miguel County Search and Rescue
notes: Reported missing 2021-05-30 after telling girlfriend of plans to run Sneffels Highline; body found ~2pm Monday by SAR using multiple aircraft. | ABC News/ABC Audio URL merged 2026-09-14 (user lead).
